equityTitle: Does the model add anything beyond a simple reversal?
equityLead: The extra features added little to Ridge in this sample. The shallow tree helped in the middle period and fell behind in the last one.
equityScope: 45 fits, up to 500 source candidates per day, three periods of 20 trading days. These dates were already studied. Historical security identities and trade execution remain unverified.
equityExplain: Reversal ranks today's bigger decliners higher for the next trading day. Rank IC measures how well the ordering matches the next day's intraday move. A higher value means better ranking. It does not tell us how much a portfolio earned.
equityChart: Daily ranking improvement over simple reversal
equityChartNote: Above zero means the selected model ranked better that day. Each point compares the same date and eligible candidates. Gaps remain unavailable.
equityTable: Ranking results for every model and period
strataNote: Groups use each feature date's eligible pool. Small or constant groups remain unavailable. These comparisons describe this sample and do not identify a cause.
cryptoTitle: Trading weekly saved costs. Coin selection still needs evidence.
cryptoLead: Weekly trend beat daily trend in 7 of 12 windows at 35 bps and 8 of 12 at 50 bps. Against either equal-weight control, it won only 5 of 12 windows at each cost.
cryptoScope: Eight fixed spot coins, twelve separate 90-day windows, USDT. A cost of 35 bps means 0.35% of each amount bought or sold. These are historical daily-price simulations.
cryptoExplain: Weekly trading starts with one allocation, then adjusts on Monday UTC decision dates. Holdings drift between adjustments. The calendar control trades on the same dates. The exposure control adjusts daily to match the trend account's current allocation to coins. Their turnover and risks differ.
cryptoChartNote: Each dot is one 90-day window and one account. Left means less trading, up means higher net return. Turnover is total traded value divided by account value at each trade, then summed. Windows are separate accounts.
cryptoTable: Cost, trading and return by window
limit: Daily prices do not prove order fills, market depth or trading capacity. No brokerage account was connected. The existing observation registry is unchanged.
